name_input: M/S TYRE TECHNO CRATS (I) PVT. LTD
export_evidence: ImportKey India customs page for TYRE TECHNOCRATS (INDIA) PRIVATE LIMITED (slug tyre-technocrats-india-private-limited): "Total Shipments 3359 Records detected ... Latest Cargo 2026-02-27"; row: "2026-02-27 | TYRE TECHNOCRATS (INDIA) PRIVATE LIMITED | TYRE TECHNOCRATS LIMITADA | NEW pneumatic Tyres of Rubber for Industrial Mining use Tyre 20.5R25 - Galaxy | NHAVA SHEVA SEA INNSA1, India | Beira, Mozambique | 40118000 | BOL 1065116"; second row: "2026-02-11 ... Tyre 460/85-26 (18.4-26) - Galaxy | NHAVA SHEVA SEA INNSA1, India | Beira, Mozambique | 40118000 | BOL 9577598"; also "2026-02-24 ... Manitou Telehandler MXT1740 | NHAVA SHEVA SEA INNSA1, India | Chingola, Tanzania | 84272000 | BOL 9962773". Source counter: page header claims 3359 shipments / 17 trading partners / 21 ports; rows actually visible on the free view = 5 (dates 2026-02-11 to 2026-02-27). Destinations seen: Mozambique (Beira), Zambia (Lusaka), Tanzania (Chingola). Declared HS 401120/401180 matches the observed 40118000 tyre lines; the 84272000 and 39171020 lines are non-tyre goods (telehandler, PU hose) shipped to group affiliates.
domestic_evidence: No domestic supply record could be retrieved. GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tender awards and annual-report splits are not public in accessible sources: volza.com, thecompanycheck.com and zaubacorp.com all returned HTTP 403 on fetch, and the web_search backend returned "Connection refused" for every query, so no domestic-side page could be located. Registered address visible on ImportKey: "101-102 INDRAPRASTH COMPLEX, GURUDWARA ROAD SHASTRI CIRCLE" (Delhi). No GSTIN, PAN, CIN or turnover figure is asserted here — null, not public in accessible sources.
note: Export side is factually confirmed, not merely declared: dated Indian customs shipping-bill records out of Nhava Sheva with B/L numbers, destination ports and HS codes, latest 2026-02-27. Pattern is intra-group distribution — the Indian entity ships OTR/mining tyres (Galaxy brand) and equipment to its own affiliates TYRE TECHNOCRATS LIMITADA (Mozambique), TYRE TECHNOCRATS (ZAMBIA) LTD and SKT GLOBAL MINING (Zambia), which also appear as buyers with 1354 / 1203 / 323 shipment counts. Note the free view shows only 5 of the claimed 3359 rows, so the volume figure is the portal's counter, not independently counted. Domestic supply: no traces found either way — this is an evidence gap (blocked registries, dead search backend), not a negative finding, hence unknown rather than none_found. Role reads as manufacturer_trader (sells Galaxy-brand tyres plus third-party Manitou telehandlers, and itself imports Monaflex/MVS repair equipment from the UK). HS 401120/401180 is consistent with the observed tyre lines; no HS correction needed. No rejection grounds: the entity is active with shipments dated 2026-02-27.
